children: Abu Dhabi-listed Modon Holding is seeking to raise a syndicated loan of 35 billion Egyptian pounds ($671.65 million) to fund the infrastructure for a project in the Wadi Yemm residential district in Ras El Hekma, Egypt, according to a news report.

First Abu Dhabi Bank Egypt is managing and arranging the syndicated loan, with several local banks likely to participate, along with UAE banks operating in Egypt, Asharq Business reported, citing unnamed sources.

This year, Modon awarded an infrastructure works contract valued at EGP 10 billion in Wadi Yemm to a consortium of Modern Engineering and the Consolidated Contractors Company. It also awarded an EGP 15 billion contract to Orascom Construction to build a mixed-use project.
In October 2024, ADQ, an Abu Dhabi-based investment and holding company, appointed Modon Holding as the master developer for the Ras El Hekma megaproject.
The Wadi Yemm area is the first mixed-use neighborhood to be developed within the megaproject.

title: Abu Dhabi's Modon seeks $671mln loan for infra works at Egypt's Ras El Hekma project: Report
